nameOfQualification: Drone - Based Telecom Operations Dy. Manager
description: Drone-Based Telecom Operations Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing drone-enabled operations in telecom infrastructure projects. The individual in this role ensures optimal use of drones for deployment, inspection, and monitoring of telecom assets by leveraging 4G/5G networks, GPS tracking, and telemetry systems. The role also involves ensuring seamless command and control (C2) communication, real-time data transmission, and cloud-based processing for operational efficiency.
